stem.text: The diagram shows four forces acting on a circular disc.

stem.alt: Circular disc with four arrows, each labelled F, attached at points on its edge: an arrow pointing up on the left side, an arrow pointing right at the top, an arrow pointing left at the bottom, and an arrow pointing down on the right side.

stem.text: Each force has magnitude $F$. Two of the forces act vertically and the other two forces act horizontally.
All four forces act in the same plane as the disc. No other forces act on the disc.

A.text: The disc is in equilibrium because the resultant force is zero.

B.text: The disc is **not** in equilibrium because the resultant force is $4F$.

C.text: The disc is in equilibrium because the resultant torque is zero.

D.text: The disc is **not** in equilibrium because the resultant torque is $2Fd$.
